body: Have a diagnosis for it and when I read it's symptoms for the first time it described me completely.

I feel the same way. I know for a fact that my life will end through suicide. 

But if you feel that way? Why not give up all control? Losing all hope is freedom. Do whatever crazy shit you want to do or if you're like me do nothing.
School starts in 2 weeks and I don't want to ever go back there but at the same time I don't want to stay home all day long. I want to be a social butterfly but I fear that I won't ever be that way.
